Name: get_gethelp_case_count
Description: Gets the total get help cases with some filtering conditions. This function should be called when user specifically uses 'get help cases' or 'gethelp cases' word in the question or have the get help context.

DataSource.BaseQuery: FN_GetHelpDataForEntityUri({entityId}) | where isnotempty(CaseNumber) and CreatedOnDateTime > todatetime({startDate})

Filters.Name: status
Filters.Description: The Status can be Open and Closed, please adjust the status accordingly based on the user Input. If both values are present then make this value null.

Filters.Name: priority
Filters.Description: User can provide multiple priority. There are 5 priority Pri 0, Pri 1, Pri 2, Pri 3, please adjust the priority accordingly based on the user input, additionally there is one more priority i.e [Confidential].

DataSource.BaseQuery: FN_GetHelpDataForEntityUri({entityId}) | where isnotempty(CaseNumber) and CreatedOnDateTime > todatetime({startDate})

Filters.Name: status
Filters.Description: Based on the user's query, the status should be determined automatically. If the question is related to resolution time or close time, avg age the status will be 'Closed'. If the question is related to for any ongoing process, the status will be 'Open'. Do not prompt the user for the status; deduce it based on the nature of the query.
